#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
todo.py — A CLI Todo App with SQLite persistence.

Usage:
    python todo.py add "Buy groceries"
    python todo.py list
    python todo.py list --all
    python todo.py complete <id>
    python todo.py delete <id>
"""

import argparse
import sqlite3
import sys
import os
from datetime import datetime

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Configuration
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
DB_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".todo.db")

# ANSI colours
RESET   = "\033[0m"
BOLD    = "\033[1m"
DIM     = "\033[2m"
GREEN   = "\033[32m"
YELLOW  = "\033[33m"
CYAN    = "\033[36m"
RED     = "\033[31m"
MAGENTA = "\033[35m"
WHITE   = "\033[37m"


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Database helpers
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def get_connection(db_path: str = DB_PATH) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """Return a database connection with row_factory set."""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


def init_db(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Create the todos table if it does not exist."""
    conn.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos (
            id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title       TEXT    NOT NULL,
            done        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at  TEXT    NOT NULL,
            updated_at  TEXT    NOT NULL
        )
        """
    )
    conn.commit()


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pretty-print helpers
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def _now_str() -> str:
    return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")


def _fmt_ts(ts: str) -> str:
    """Format a timestamp for display."""
    try:
        dt = datetime.strptime(ts, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        return dt.strftime("%b %d %Y  %H:%M")
    except ValueError:
        return ts


def _status_badge(done: int) -> str:
    if done:
        return f"{GREEN}✔ done   {RESET}"
    return f"{YELLOW}○ pending{RESET}"


def _separator(width: int = 72) -> str:
    return f"{DIM}{'─' * width}{RESET}"


def print_header() -> None:
    print(f"\n{BOLD}{CYAN}{'─' * 72}{RESET}")
    print(
        f"{BOLD}{CYAN}"
        f"  {'ID':<5} {'STATUS':<12} {'TITLE':<35} {'CREATED':<18}"
        f"{RESET}"
    )
    print(f"{BOLD}{CYAN}{'─' * 72}{RESET}")


def print_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> None:
    title = row["title"]
    if len(title) > 34:
        title = title[:31] + "..."
    done_str  = _status_badge(row["done"])
    title_col = f"{DIM}{title}{RESET}" if row["done"] else title
    print(
        f"  {MAGENTA}{row['id']:<5}{RESET}"
        f" {done_str:<23}"
        f" {title_col:<35}"
        f" {DIM}{_fmt_ts(row['created_at'])}{RESET}"
    )


def print_footer(count: int) -> None:
    print(_separator())
    print(f"  {DIM}{count} item(s) shown{RESET}\n")


def print_detail(row: sqlite3.Row) -> None:
    """Print a single todo in detail view."""
    print(_separator())
    print(f"  {BOLD}ID      :{RESET}  {MAGENTA}{row['id']}{RESET}")
    print(f"  {BOLD}Title   :{RESET}  {row['title']}")
    print(f"  {BOLD}Status  :{RESET}  {_status_badge(row['done'])}")
    print(f"  {BOLD}Created :{RESET}  {DIM}{_fmt_ts(row['created_at'])}{RESET}")
    print(f"  {BOLD}Updated :{RESET}  {DIM}{_fmt_ts(row['updated_at'])}{RESET}")
    print(_separator())


def ok(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"\n  {GREEN}✔  {msg}{RESET}\n")


def err(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"\n  {RED}✖  {msg}{RESET}\n", file=sys.stderr)


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# CRUD operations
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def cmd_add(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> int:
    """Insert a new todo and return its id."""
    title = title.strip()
    if not title:
        err("Title cannot be empty.")
        return 1
    now = _now_str()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO todos (title, done, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, 0, ?, ?)",
        (title, now, now),
    )
    conn.commit()
    ok(f"Added todo #{cur.lastrowid}: \"{title}\"")
    return 0


def cmd_list(conn: sqlite3.Connection, show_all: bool = False) -> int:
    """List todos. By default only pending; --all shows completed too."""
    if show_all:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM todos ORDER BY done ASC, id ASC"
        ).fetchall()
    else:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM todos WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id ASC"
        ).fetchall()

    if not rows:
        label = "todos" if show_all else "pending todos"
        print(f"\n  {DIM}No {label} found.{RESET}\n")
        return 0

    label = "All todos" if show_all else "Pending todos"
    print(f"\n  {BOLD}{label}{RESET}")
    print_header()
    for row in rows:
        print_row(row)
    print_footer(len(rows))
    return 0


def cmd_complete(conn: sqlite3.Connection, todo_id: int) -> int:
    """Mark a todo as complete."""
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        err(f"No todo with id {todo_id}.")
        return 1
    if row["done"]:
        err(f"Todo #{todo_id} is already marked as done.")
        return 1
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE todos SET done = 1, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (_now_str(), todo_id),
    )
    conn.commit()
    ok(f"Marked todo #{todo_id} as complete: \"{row['title']}\"")
    return 0


def cmd_delete(conn: sqlite3.Connection, todo_id: int) -> int:
    """Permanently delete a todo."""
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        err(f"No todo with id {todo_id}.")
        return 1
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,))
    conn.commit()
    ok(f"Deleted todo #{todo_id}: \"{row['title']}\"")
    return 0


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Argument parser
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="todo",
        description=f"{BOLD}A simple CLI Todo app with SQLite persistence.{RESET}",
        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
        epilog=(
            "Examples:\n"
            "  todo add \"Write unit tests\"\n"
            "  todo list\n"
            "  todo list --all\n"
            "  todo complete 3\n"
            "  todo delete 3\n"
        ),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--db",
        default=DB_PATH,
        metavar="PATH",
        help=f"Path to the SQLite database (default: {DB_PATH})",
    )

    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", metavar="COMMAND")
    sub.required = True

    # add
    p_add = sub.add_parser("add", help="Add a new todo item")
    p_add.add_argument("title", help="Title / description of the todo")

    # list
    p_list = sub.add_parser("list", help="List todo items")
    p_list.add_argument(
        "--all", "-a",
        action="store_true",
        dest="show_all",
        help="Show completed todos as well",
    )

    # complete
    p_complete = sub.add_parser("complete", help="Mark a todo as completed")
    p_complete.add_argument("id", type=int, help="ID of the todo to complete")

    # delete
    p_delete = sub.add_parser("delete", help="Delete a todo permanently")
    p_delete.add_argument("id", type=int, help="ID of the todo to delete")

    return parser


# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Entry point
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        conn = get_connection(args.db)
        init_db(conn)
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        err(f"Database error: {exc}")
        return 1

    try:
        if args.command == "add":
            return cmd_add(conn, args.title)

        elif args.command == "list":
            return cmd_list(conn, show_all=args.show_all)

        elif args.command == "complete":
            return cmd_complete(conn, args.id)

        elif args.command == "delete":
            return cmd_delete(conn, args.id)

        else:
            parser.print_help()
            return 1

    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        err(f"Database error: {exc}")
        return 1
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print(f"\n{DIM}Aborted.{RESET}\n")
        return 130
    finally:
        conn.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
